root_cause.description: The payment service container has exited (code 137), causing checkout requests to fail due to inability to resolve the service address.

evidence.explanation: The payment container is in an exited state with exit code 137, indicating it was terminated (likely by the system).
Frontend logs confirm that checkout requests are failing because they cannot reach the payment service due to a DNS resolution error.
